project.domain: Ecosystem integration portal and control plane
project.mission: Catalog independent repositories and expose versioned integration contracts, links, metadata, and browser-side demonstrations.

explicit_non_goals: Do not convert independent repositories into one monolithic runtime
Browser labs use synthetic/local models and do not execute native C
Registry/catalog membership does not grant execution or hardware access

safety_boundaries: Treat registry and remote repository metadata as untrusted input and validate schemas.
Browser labs remain demonstrations unless a separately reviewed runtime integration is implemented.
Do not imply that listing a repository proves its build, security, or runtime compatibility.
External links and integration contracts must remain explicit and versioned.

native_validation.evidence_note: Existing mesh-contract checks remain responsible for cross-repository contract validation.
